items.information:
***First time participants***
Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA
Step 2 - Register for the competition
Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab.

***Other participants***
Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions
Step 2 - Register for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned)
Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab.

Age category special prizes for under-8, under-10 & under-12 participants.

*Last date for registration & payment* - August 10th, 2017

Leave a WhatsApp message on +91 9052529279 if you have additional queries.
